title: Aggravating Factors
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask for activities rather than movements.
Ask about stairs up and stairs down separately, because they load differently and the answer differs.
Ask how soon the pain comes on: immediately, after a distance, or the following day.
Ask whether the activity has to be stopped or merely hurts, since the two are different severities.
Ask whether the provoking loading is loading the operation would change.
